row.evidence: Okta's Teampay catalogue app (last updated June 2022) ticks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update and Deactivate, but Teampay/Paystand publish no SCIM, SSO or pricing documentation.
row.notes: New row. Teampay was acquired by Paystand and is now sold as 'Teampay by Paystand' expense management; teampay.co redirects to paystand.com/expenses. Paystand's pricing page describes flat subscription pricing with no public price list, and the Teampay product has no public plans. The old Teampay help centre is gone, and the Paystand help centre and developer docs have no Teampay SSO, SCIM or user-management articles. The only SCIM evidence is Okta's OIN app, so the status stays unknown under rule 6a.
